ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the ongoing Medicaid fraud investigation in Minnesota, including allegations against Ilhan Omar and the Feeding Our Future nonprofit
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are federal investigators handling the case?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme, and following the money trail could lead to significant findings. I recommend starting with publicly available documents and interviewing sources close to the investigation.
